extracted.intended_audience: patent litigators, judges, and counsel drafting or using jury instructions in patent trials
extracted.subtask_description: Model jury instructions for patent litigation provided by AIPLA, intended as neutral, precedentially‑based templates that litigants should adapt to the specific issues of their case and use alongside non‑patent instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Neutrality
rubrics_metrics.description: The 2025 Model Patent Jury Instructions are a neutral set of jury instructions that are not biased in favor of either the patent owner or the accused infringer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the instructions as neutral templates rather than documents favoring one party; ensure any edits preserve neutrality unless case facts justify a non‑neutral formulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope (not exhaustive)
rubrics_metrics.description: These Instructions are not intended to address every conceivable issue that might arise in patent litigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize that the model covers typical issues only; do not assume it covers obscure or highly fact‑specific matters—supplement or draft new instructions as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Precedential support for included guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance is provided on those issues that typically arise in patent litigation and that have clear precedential support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer model instructions where there is clear case law or precedent; where precedent is lacking or unsettled, consider tailoring language or providing alternative instructions with citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailoring to specific case issues and eliminating superfluous/confusing instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: The litigants must tailor these instructions to the specific issues in their particular case and to eliminate superfluous or confusing instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Edit the templates to reflect the parties' claims, defenses, and the actual evidence; remove any instructions irrelevant to the case or wording that could confuse the jury.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use with non‑patent instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: These instructions are intended to be used in conjunction with other instructions dealing with issues that are not specific to patent law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine the patent‑specific model instructions with standard civil/criminal/jury instructions (e.g., burden of proof, verdict form, evidentiary instructions) to produce a complete jury charge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability and versioning (formats and redlines)
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions are provided in PDF and WORD format; redline files showing updates and changes compared to the 2024 AIPLA Model Patent Jury Instructions are also available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download the appropriate format for editing (Word for customization); review redlines to see recent changes and ensure citations/language reflect the current (2025) version.
